A.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Equalize fraction units
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when the given fractional units do not already match.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD/common denominator.
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions so they share a denominator.
Tag for mixed-number items if only the fractional parts are converted to a common denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag mere rewriting of a whole number as a mixed number with 0 over a denominator unless equivalent-fraction conversion is also done.
Do not tag simplification after subtraction.

skills.name: Normalize composite numbers
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or nonstandard mixed number into a compatible whole-and-fraction form so the subtraction can be carried out componentwise.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a denominator.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized to a standard mixed number.
Tag when a mixed number is explicitly decomposed into whole and fractional parts to set up subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction of already compatible fractions or mixed numbers when no rewriting occurs.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping after subtraction has begun.
Do not tag finding a common denominator unless the step also performs one of the rewrites above.

skills.name: Subtract corresponding parts
skills.definition: Subtract numerators of like fractions and/or subtract whole parts and fraction parts separately, then combine the result when no regrouping is needed.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when like-denominator fractions are subtracted directly.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted separately.
Tag when the resulting whole and fractional parts are combined into the final number, provided no borrowing step is the focus.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is to create common denominators.
Do not tag steps whose main purpose is borrowing/regrouping because a fractional part would be negative.
Do not tag simplification-only steps such as reducing 2/10 to 1/5 or 0/3 to 0.

skills.name: Regroup and simplify
skills.definition: Borrow one whole to resolve a negative fractional difference and reduce the resulting fraction or zero form to lowest terms.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it into denominator-over-denominator fractional units.
Tag when regrouping is used after an initial negative fractional difference.
Tag when a step simplifies a fraction or zero result to lowest terms after subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag direct subtraction steps that do not require borrowing and do not simplify.
Do not tag normalization rewrites such as converting 2 3/2 to 3 1/2.
Do not tag common-denominator conversion before subtraction.

B.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Equalize fraction units
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions so they can be subtracted.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a solution explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when fraction parts are converted to equivalent fractions before subtraction.
Tag for mixed-number items if only the fractional parts are equalized.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag mere rewriting of a whole number as n + 0/d unless it is part of denominator equalization.
Do not tag simplification after subtraction.

skills.name: Normalize mixed forms
skills.definition: Rewrite a quantity into a workable form for subtraction, such as converting a mixed number with an improper fraction part to a standard mixed number or expressing a whole number as a whole plus 0/d.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number like 2 3/2 or 1 4/3 is normalized before subtraction.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus a zero fraction, such as 3 + 0/5.
Tag when a mixed number is explicitly separated into whole and fractional parts for subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary common-denominator conversion of proper fractions.
Do not tag borrowing from the whole part after subtraction has begun.
Do not tag final recombination of whole and fractional results.

skills.name: Subtract fractional expressions
skills.definition: Carry out the subtraction once forms are aligned, including subtracting numerators with a common denominator and subtracting whole and fractional parts in mixed-number problems when no regrouping is needed.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts are subtracted directly in a mixed-number problem.
Tag when the result is combined from already-subtracted whole and fractional parts, provided no borrowing step is involved.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is finding a common denominator or converting forms.
Do not tag regrouping or borrowing steps used because the fractional part would be negative.
Do not tag simplification to lowest terms.

skills.name: Regroup or simplify result
skills.definition: Adjust the subtraction result by borrowing/regrouping when the fractional part is negative, and/or reduce the final fraction or zero form to lowest terms.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when 1 is borrowed from the whole part and converted into denominator/denominator to continue subtraction.
Tag when a fraction result is simplified, such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when 0/3 or 0/8 is simplified to 0 or when a zero fractional part is absorbed into a whole-number result.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag direct subtraction steps that do not involve regrouping.
Do not tag initial normalization of mixed numbers or whole numbers.
Do not tag common-denominator conversion before subtraction.

C.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Equalize fraction units
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions with that denominator before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions so the denominator matches.
Tag for mixed-number items when only the fractional parts are converted to a common denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number unless it also includes denominator equalization.
Do not tag simplification after subtraction.

skills.name: Normalize composite numbers
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or nonstandard mixed number into a compatible whole-and-fraction form for subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a denominator.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized to a standard mixed number.
Tag when a mixed number is explicitly decomposed into whole and fractional parts to align the subtraction structure.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction of already compatible whole and fraction parts.
Do not tag borrowing from the whole part; that is a separate regrouping action.
Do not tag finding a common denominator unless a number is also being structurally rewritten.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract numerators for like fractions and/or subtract the whole-number and fractional parts once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when like fractions are subtracted directly by subtracting numerators.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted separately.
Tag when the subtraction produces a zero or negative fractional part before any borrowing step.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is creating common denominators.
Do not tag regrouping or borrowing to fix a negative fractional result.
Do not tag simplification or final recombination alone unless subtraction is actually performed in that step.

skills.name: Regroup and simplify
skills.definition: Borrow or regroup across the whole and fractional parts when needed, then reduce the resulting fraction or express the result as a whole/mixed number in lowest terms.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when 1 whole is borrowed and converted into fractional units to continue subtraction.
Tag when a fraction result is simplified to lowest terms.
Tag when a zero fraction is reduced to a whole number or when the final result is expressed in proper mixed-number/integer form after regrouping or reduction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag straightforward subtraction steps that require no borrowing and no reduction.
Do not tag initial rewriting of whole numbers or improper mixed numbers before subtraction.
Do not tag common-denominator conversion.
